author: Cinna Davis (substantial AI assistance)
statement: The local invertible charge rescaling q^(2(len(mu)+len(nu))) gives a new scalar-filter space while preserving both directional ranks at each charge evaluation. Complete exact finite classifications on the PR 19 codebooks find an actual normalized crossing at lambda=2,h=6 after removing every shift -6,...,6; the raw space is already singular at cutoff 5 and the new entire scalar matrix space is singular at cutoff 7. At lambda=1,h=4 the new space has a full-rank crossing through cutoff 4 and none at cutoff 5. Exact scalar-span membership checks at h=4, h=6 and h=7 further recover the invertible highest-charge first-moment minor using only shifts |s|>=h. These finite witnesses do not prove uniform recovery, an all-size filter, leading capacity, smaller rho or improved SAT exponent.
remaining_obligations: All-size scalarity and full-rank existence for a constant-fraction central shift filter
Leading row, column and output codebook capacity
Polynomial piece count, uniform entry generation, coefficient heights and both directional rank envelopes
Complete rational transfer and master recursion composition
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance; no independent or formal review
